Customers are limited to withdrawals of Rs 5,000 over the next six months. The bank's recent lack of compliance with supervisory concerns prompted these regulatory actions. items.title: Govt flags Programme Code violations by TV channels, urges caution on AI use

Additionally, the ministry reiterated prohibitions on inappropriate content and live coverage of anti-terrorist operations.
